experiment: gVisor vs Reverie syscall-interception benchmark (v2, steady-state)
owner: hermit-178 (resumed from hermit-165 after OOMD kill)

host.load_caveat: system load ~300-400 during runs; medians are directional, not publication-grade

methodology.backend_rotation: backend order rotated by round to spread interference

workloads.getpid-3s: dynamic C fixture, 40,000,000 getpid() calls (exact op count)
workloads.find-usr: /usr/bin/find /usr -type f; expected exit 1 (3 unreadable host dirs); ~3.019M syscalls
workloads.dd-byte-io: dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/null bs=1 count=15000000 (30M read+write ops, exact)
workloads.sqlite-100k: sqlite3 :memory: 100K-row insert + index + 900 full scans; COMPUTE-bound (~167 syscalls)

compatibility_exclusions.reverie-kvm: cannot run find-usr / dd-byte-io / tar-doc (ENOSYS: /usr, /dev/zero, /dev/null); passes getpid-3s and sqlite-100k only
